# pidginhost_volume (Resource)

A block storage volume, attached to a server.

The API can only create a volume on a server (`POST /api/cloud/servers/{id}/volumes/`), so `server_id` is required. Changing `server_id` moves the volume in place (detach, then attach); the data is kept. Growing `size` resizes the volume online; shrinking it is not possible and replaces the volume, **destroying its data**.

Do not also manage the same volume with `pidginhost_volume_attachment`; that resource is for volumes created outside this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_volume" "data" {
  server_id = pidginhost_server.db.id
  product   = "ssd" # see the pidginhost_storage_products data source
  size      = 100   # GB; can grow in place
  alias     = "db-data"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) Storage product, as a slug (see `pidginhost_storage_products`) or ID. Changing it replaces the volume.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server the volume is created on and attached to. Changing it moves the volume to another server without losing data.
- `size` (Number) Size in GB. Increasing it resizes the volume online; decreasing it replaces the volume.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Name of the volume, up to 50 characters. Can be changed in place.
- `project` (String) Project label. Can be changed in place.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `attached` (Boolean) Whether the volume is attached.
- `id` (String) Volume ID.
- `server_hostname` (String) Hostname of the server the volume is attached to.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a volume by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_volume.data 123
```
